scope: digital planning, not RF latency certification
bounds: bounds_valid=1 is caller evidence for finite measured limits and continuous samples during rearm. Backpressure or unknown scheduler/service bounds => UNBOUNDED. Use checked u64 additions; never wrap.
submit_gate: cal_replay_budgeted_begin derives task count/reference/target from serialized task, writes no MMIO on budget rejection. PL live qualification/identity/lease/deadline checks remain mandatory.
